messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: service/inference-api v2.4.0 -> canary 10% in us-east-1 (ts: 1768001234)
incident-bot: Alert: canary-error-rate > 5% (5m avg) for inference-api-canary - paging oncall
maria (oncall): ack - looking
kevin: seeing 504s and timeouts on canary pods, tailing logs now
danielle: support: customer reports spike in latency on hosted endpoint /v1/generate
maria (oncall): initiating manual rollback to v2.3.8 and enable kill-switch flag
maria (oncall): run: kubectl set image deployment/inference-api inference-api=redwood/inference:2.3.8 -n prod
ops-runner: executing, hitting image pull conflict on some nodes, retrying
kevin: also toggling feature flag 'feature:rollout_2_4' -> off (LaunchDarkly)
danielle: support: notifying impacted customers in US-EAST, no P0 yet
ai-telemetry: canary error-rate dropping to 1.2% after kill-switch
maria (oncall): traffic draining in progress, switching traffic back to baseline
kevin: smoke test: send 10 requests -> all 200, p95 latency 120ms
maria (oncall): executing post-rollback verification checklist:
- check logs for exceptions
- ensure no resource leaks
- monitor for 5m
kevin: logs show OOM spikes on canary pods - investigating memory config
maria (oncall): flagging infra:ooms tag, follow-up in eng-runtime
danielle: support: sent status update to affected customers, used internal SLACK template
ops-runner: all canary pods terminated and replaced with stable image
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-00079 severity: medium (oncall acknowledged)
maria (oncall): handing off to eng-runtime for root cause + fix, oncall remains until verification end
kevin: assigning ticket to @eng-runtime
danielle: any ETA for fix? need to update customers
maria (oncall): ETA initial triage 1h, will update in incident doc
ai-telemetry: metrics look stable for 12m, no regression on embeddings
maria (oncall): closing live mitigation thread, will keep incident open for RCA
kevin: leaving notes: command outputs, logs archived to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1768001234/
ops-runner: remember to run canary with lower concurrency and an adjusted mem limit when reattempting
danielle: thanks - good job team :thumbsup:
